decisions.reason: Underground LHD loaders build directly on the firm's long engineering experience with underground mining and tunnelling vehicles, so it can interpret early market feedback and keep improving the line through its existing application and service know-how.

Underground dump trucks share drivetrains, safety systems and customer base with the loaders and the firm's core underground equipment, giving it the related knowledge to assimilate learnings and refine the product rather than abandon it after one year.
